privacy_policy_body:
**Last updated:** July 2026

Samyag Synergy ("we", "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting personal data in accordance with Singapore's Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).

### What we collect
When you visit this website, we use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use our site — this may include your approximate location, device/browser type, pages viewed, and general behaviour on the site. We do not collect your name, email, or phone number unless you choose to contact us directly (e.g. by emailing or calling us).

### Why we collect it
We use this information to understand which content is useful to visitors, improve the website, and measure the reach of our services and free resources. We do not sell or share your data with third parties for marketing purposes.

### Cookies and analytics consent
This site asks for your consent before loading analytics cookies. You can decline, and the site will continue to function normally without analytics tracking. You can change your choice at any time by clearing your browser's site data for this website and reloading the page.

### Your rights
Under the PDPA, you have the right to ask what personal data we hold about you (where applicable), request correction, and withdraw consent for its use. To exercise any of these rights, contact our Data Protection Officer below.

### Data retention
Analytics data is retained only as long as necessary for the purposes described above, in line with Google Analytics' standard retention settings.

### Contact our Data Protection Officer
If you have questions about this policy or how your data is handled, contact:

**Neelukumari Jain**
samyagsynergy@gmail.com

### Changes to this policy
We may update this policy from time to time. The "last updated" date above reflects the most recent revision.

*This policy is provided as a general reference and does not constitute legal advice.*
